cliArgAuditFuzz: kodhi yekuchenesa / kuverenga isina bvunzo yakavakirwa pazvimiro (fuzz) (mushumo chete, haumbokundikane; --format json kuma-agent)
auditFuzzStart: Kodhi yekuchenesa nekuverenga isina bvunzo yezvimiro: {path}
auditFuzzNothing: Hapana mabasa ekuchenesa kana ekuverenga awanikwa nezita (sanitize*, parse*, escape*, ...), hapana chekushuma.
auditFuzzTotals: Mabasa ekuchenesa / ekuverenga {candidates}: {covered} anotaurwa mubvunzo yefast-check, {uncovered} haatauri (mafaira ebvunzo dzezvimiro {tests} awanikwa)
auditFuzzAllCovered: Basa rimwe nerimwe rekuchenesa / rekuverenga rawanikwa rinotaurwa mubvunzo yezvimiro.
auditFuzzOutro: Mushumo chete, hapana chakundikana. {command} inonyora bvunzo yefuzz yekutanga yechinhu; {json} inopa mushumo unoverengwa nemuchina.
wcFuzzBadName: "{name}" harisi zita rechinhu chakagadzirwa (mabhii madiki ane dash, se my-element). Mhanyisa izvi mufolda yechinhu kana kuti ipa --name.
wcFuzzNoElement: Hapana {file} mufolda ino. Mhanyisa izvi mufolda yechinhu, kana kuti ipa --name yechimwe chinhu chepurojekiti ino.
wcFuzzConfigExists: {file} yatovepo uye yasiiwa zvayakaita. Bvunzo yefuzz inomhanya nembeu yayo yakatarwa; kuti utsvage nembeu yemukana kana kudzokorora kukundikana, pa zvinosiyana zveHAX_FUZZ_* kupeji yebvunzo kubva mugadziriro iyoyo.
wcFuzzNext: Mhanyisa {install} kuti uwedzere fast-check, wobva wamhanyisa {test}. {hunt} inotsvaga nembeu yemukana; kukundikana kunodhinda mbeu nenzira zvinokudzokorora.
wcFuzzNextMonorepo: Mhanyisa {command} mufolda yechinhu ichi. Kutsvaga kwefuzz kwemonorepo kweusiku kunotora mafaira e*-fuzz.test.js koga.
